claim_boundary: This is an inference-only OpenAI CLIP reference under the exact shared ImageNet-normalized preprocessing and frozen-feature classifiers used by the bounded Vision 1B diagnostic. OpenAI CLIP was trained on roughly 400 million image-text pairs and normally uses CLIP-specific normalization, so this primary result compares strict shared-protocol transfer but not data efficiency, compute efficiency, training method, or best native-preprocessing CLIP performance.

evaluation.feature: 512-dimensional projected OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 visual feature before L2 normalization
evaluation.preprocessing: repeat grayscale to RGB, bicubic resize to 224x224, ImageNet mean/std normalization

ridge_probe.selection: deterministic stratified 80/20 split of the official training set; refit on all training examples after lambda selection

model.pretraining: OpenAI CLIP image-text pretraining, approximately 400 million pairs
